author: whoishiring
text:
Please state the location and include REMOTE for remote work, REMOTE (US) or similar if the country is restricted, and ONSITE when remote work is not an option.

Please only post if you personally are part of the hiring company—no recruiting firms or job boards. One post per company. If it isn't a household name, explain what your company does.

Please only post if you are actively filling a position and are committed to replying to applicants.

Commenters: please don't reply to job posts to complain about something. It's off topic here.

Readers: please only email if you are personally interested in the job.

Searchers: try https://gethnjobs.com/, https://hnwork.app, https://dheerajck.github.io/hnwhoishiring/, http://nchelluri.github.io/hnjobs/, https://hnjobs.emilburzo.com.

Don't miss this other fine thread: Who wants to be hired? https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50338726
title: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (November 2026)

children.text:
eventfirst | Senior Full-Stack Engineer | Berlin, Germany | REMOTE (CET) | Full-time | eventfirst.com

We are applying AI to organize corporate events.

We are looking for a senior engineer with at least ten years of full stack experience, a strong focus on product and UX, and some experience building an AI chat based product.

Our tech stack is Typescript, React, Next.js and Tailwind. On the backend we use Drizzle with Neon, deployed and monitored via Vercel. Agents and background jobs are executed via trigger.dev. This gives us a killer DX because the entire tech stack supports preview branching. This allows coding agents to work in parallel on different features and verify their work independently very close to what will run in prod. CI is fast (2-3 min) and coverage is good enough to deploy to prod many times per day.

Please note that we are working remotely in the CET timezone. Having some remote experience is a plus.

We have pre-seed funding from a major US VC and are experienced founders. You’ll be working alongside the founders (ex-Apple, ex-Airbnb, ex-Tulip, ex-Tourlane) and will have a chance to shape the company, product and of course the engineering culture.

Apply here: https://eventfirst.jobs.personio.com/job/2870690?_pc=3355738

children.text:
Proxima Fusion | Senior Software Engineer (Dev Platform) | Munich, Germany | ONSITE | Full-time

We're building the world's first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. First spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics, based on Wendelstein 7-X (the largest stellarator ever built), €650M+ raised, teams in Munich, Zurich and Oxford.

Finding a good stellarator design means searching an enormous high-dimensional space, and every candidate design needs heavy plasma physics simulation. That's the compute problem this role owns: cloud + HPC clusters, K8s, Ray, Dask, and the platform work around it (CI/CD, IaC, observability).

You'd sit directly next to the physicists and AI researchers burning through that compute, so you see exactly what your infrastructure unlocks. Python and Linux.

If you've wanted to point your platform engineering skills at something that actually matters, clean, abundant energy, this is about as direct a shot as it gets, and it's happening in Europe.

Interview process: recruiter call, meet the team lead, technical panel, meet the CEO.

children.text:
NetBird | Berlin, Germany (or remote, CET overlap) | Full-time

https://netbird.io/careers NetBird is open source networking and access control WireGuard-based overlay networks with zero-config peer-to-peer connectivity. Now working with new use cases in access for AI agents. Open source, built in Europe, used by thousands of teams worldwide. We're a small and growing team going up against (and working with) the incumbents in network security. Post Series A with 10xd revenue since the raise.

- Senior/Staff Backend Engineer (Go!!) : the control plane: peer coordination, policy and access control, multi-tenancy, and keeping it all fast as customer networks grow into the hundreds of thousands of peers.

- Networking/Client Software Engineer (Go!!) — Software Engineering on the NetBird client side: WireGuard, NAT traversal and hole punching, relays, DNS, and shipping one client across Linux, macOS, Windows. - Technical Product Owner: Turn feedback into a clear roadmap, and work closely with the team to ship it. You should be comfortable with networking concepts and enjoy talking to users as much as reading a spec.

- Technical Support Engineer: Help customers set up and debug NetBird in real environments (WireGuard, Linux, cloud, Kubernetes) and pass what you learn back to engineering. (REMOTE - US/EST hours)

We have an office in Berlin and mostly work CET. We'd love to have you in the office with us, but if your experience is stellar we're happy to hire remote. We're scaling quickly, so this is a chance to join early and scale with us.

Apply at https://netbird.io/careers, please mention you found us on Hacker News in your application.

Curiosity (https://curiosity.ai) | Forward Deployed Engineer, DevOps Architect | Toulouse, France | ONSITE | Full-time (CDI) | Visa support

We're bootstrapped, profitable and based in Munich. Our customers are large industrial and regulated companies, Airbus among them, and Studio has 30TB+ of data connected in production.

We are starting a team in Toulouse that works at customer sites, in French and English, along with the engineers who build Studio.

Forward Deployed Engineer: take a customer's problem from the first workshop to production. You decide with them what Studio should build, connect their systems, model the data as a graph, and oversee the C#/.NET connectors and services it needs. You also ship features and agents on top.

DevOps Architect: Own deployments in customer environments, from the first technical discussion to handover, on private clouds or data centers. Networking, IAM, Linux, Docker, monitoring, backups, upgrades, incidents. You also write code alongside the forward deployed engineers.

We're looking for hands-on builders who enjoy working directly with customers. Full-stack project experience preferred. Fluent French and English required.

CV to jobs@curiosity.ai, mention Hacker News. Details: https://curiosity.ai/careers/
